notes.title: Patch Notes - 0.1.1934
notes.content:
General:
- Fixed bug with new input systemconcerning keyboard control

Bots:
- Fixed a bug where Level 0 bots won't attack

notes.title: Patch Notes - 0.1.1931
notes.content:
General:
- Updated to a new Inputsystem version (should fix some bugs with gamepads)
- fixed a bug where the basic ability (RT) would not auto fire

notes.title: Patch Notes - 0.1.1923
notes.content:
General:
* fixed bug where game hangs on end of match in singleplayer challange (Thanks to the community for the bug report screenshot!)

notes.title: Patch Notes - 0.1.1918
notes.content:
General:
* Bot AI improvements (paladin & battlemage)
* Fixed a bug where battlemages's electrical orb could trigger twice
* Performance improvements

notes.title: Patch Notes - 0.1.1913
notes.content:
New game mode: "Singleplayer Challange"

In a quick fight against bots you will learn to master your classes!
Difficulty will increase as you progress (or decrease if you cannot handle it!)

General:
* Decrease player spawn animation
* Fixed a bug where kills displays would be visible on shadowkiller in stealth
* Fix cooldown hud bug
* Added player damage panel

notes.title: Patch Notes - 0.1.1905
notes.content:
Graphics:
- Adjust all lighting
- Changed buff/debuff texts to be more clear

notes.title: Patch Notes - 0.1.1900
notes.content:
Powerups:
- Show remaining time indicator

General:
- Add buff scroling combat texts
- fix a bug where AOE damage did work through walls
- improved combat informations

notes.title: Patch Notes - 0.1.1886
notes.content:
New Graphics!
- reworked Hellforge map graphics
- Buffs/Debuffs are now shown as outline on players for better indication
- Reworked in-game UI
- Reworked powerup gfx

General:
- Decreased powerup spawn interval from 15 to 10
- Fixed bug where whitcher's shuriken wouldn't despawn when returning to owner

notes.title: Patch Notes - 0.1.1881
notes.content:
New Graphics!

Iceworld map & Graphics rework
- Player shadows
- Day/Night cycle
- Reworked Iceworld graphics
- Teleporters now working!

General:
- Fixed some issues with the main-menu and in-game menu

notes.title: Patch Notes - 0.1.1876
notes.content:
General:
- Add "Restart match" buttons to in-game menus
- Fixed a bug where the in-game kills display wasn't working

notes.title: Patch Notes - 0.1.1874
notes.content:
General:
- fixed character selection screen UI bug
- Add more stats to "Character Info" screen

Shadowkiller:
- Decrease average damage of melee attack by 1

notes.title: Patch Notes - 0.1.1871
notes.content:
General:
- Rework character selection screen
- Add "Character Info" screen

notes.title: Patch Notes - 0.1.1857
notes.content:
General:
- Added "Bot Add/Remove" keyboard binding icons
- Make intro skippable via key/mouse/button click
- Remove self-damage for all abilities and characters
- Game can now run in background (important for multi screen setups)
- Add keyboard key bindings screen to "How to play"

Shadowkiller:
- Fix bug where powerup light glow is visible when collecting powerups during stealth

notes.title: Patch Notes - 0.1.1854
notes.content:
General:
- Improve physics collision detection
  - Fixes bugs where players could be pushed/grabbed through walls

Paladin:
- Increase "Grip/Pull" (LT) force from 600 to 800

Battlemage:
- Increase "Frost Nova" (LT) range from 4 to 5

Shadowkiller:
- Decrease "Wounding Hit" (RB/Ultimate) DoT damage from 30 to 20 (over 5 seconds)

Witcher:
- Change LT and LB abilities buttons (Dodge & Daze)

notes.title: Patch Notes - 0.1.1798
notes.content:
- Increased Witcher base movement speed factor from 1.2 to 1.25
- PS4 controller support now working
- changed build to support x64 CPUs
